miamiNews.title: Innocent woman says police use of Flock camera led to 13 days in jail
miamiNews.description: Lindsey Brooke Isaacs spent 13 days in jail after a Flock camera flagged her Dodge Durango near a fatal Florida crash that killed three people.

tip.title: Date Night Idea: Swap Bucket Lists
tip.content: Ask your girlfriend to share 3 things on her bucket list you didn't know about. Listen without planning. Then share yours. This creates deeper connection in 15 minutes.
